scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm ci:check && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm python:check
scripts.python:check: ./scripts/uv.sh run --project services/agent --no-sync ruff check services/agent scripts
scripts.python:format: ./scripts/uv.sh run --project services/agent --no-sync ruff format services/agent scripts
scripts.contracts:generate: ./scripts/uv.sh run --project services/agent --no-sync python scripts/export_openapi.py && pnpm --filter @careerflow/contracts generate && pnpm exec prettier --write packages/contracts/openapi.json packages/contracts/src/generated.ts
